description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the exact 5-dimension scoring rubric (completeness 30pts, freshness 25pts, structure 20pts, density 15pts, consistency 10pts) and all their sub-checks. 2. It must inspect the workspace: count P0 items in MEMORY.md (finds only 2, not ≥3 → 0pts), check whether today's log exists in memory/logs/ (it does not → 0pts), check mtime of memory/INDEX.md (4 days old, outside 3-day window → 0pts for that freshness sub-check), verify .issues/ has ≥3 open issues (only 2 open, 3 are closed → 0pts), compute average log line count (approximately 10 lines across 6 logs, below the 20-line threshold → 0pts), and detect INDEX.md ↔ MEMORY.md inconsistencies (ghost entries and missing issue-099.md → 0pts for both consistency sub-checks). 3. Passing sub-checks: MEMORY.md exists+has content (10pts), INDEX.md exists (5pts), logs within 7 days (10pts), MEMORY.md updated within 7 days (10pts), .issues/ directory exists (10pts), heartbeat.json correctly formed (5pts), MEMORY.md is 480 lines within 50-500 range (10pts). Total = 25+10+15+10+0 = 60. 4. The agent must map score 60 to the Chinese grade label '警告' (50-69 band) — NOT English, NOT '警告 (Warning)', just '警告'. 5. The output health-score.json must use the exact keys 'timestamp', 'totalScore', 'grade', 'dimensions' (with 'score', 'max', 'issues' per dimension), and 'recommendations', matching the schema in SKILL.md.
